topic: Decide whether to build the new feature in-house or outsource it

scenario.topic: Decide whether to build the new feature in-house or outsource it
scenario.opening_question: What matters most when deciding whether to build the new feature in-house or outsource it?

options.name: In-House Development
options.upside: Full control over the development process
options.tradeoff: High upfront costs and resource allocation
options.concern: Potential delays due to internal resource constraints
options.best_for: Companies with existing expertise and resources

options.name: Outsourced Development
options.upside: Faster development and lower upfront costs
options.tradeoff: Less control over the development process and potential quality issues
options.concern: Dependence on external vendors and potential communication breakdowns
options.best_for: Companies with limited resources or expertise

options.name: Hybrid Development
options.tradeoff: Higher overall costs compared to outsourcing
options.concern: Potential integration challenges between internal and external teams
options.best_for: Companies with some existing expertise but needing additional support

options.name: Open-Source Solution
options.upside: Zero upfront costs and community-driven development
options.tradeoff: Limited control over the development process and potential security risks
options.concern: Dependence on community support and potential lack of customization options
options.best_for: Companies with limited budgets and simple feature requirements

personas.name: Ava
personas.private_goal: Ensure the new feature is developed efficiently and effectively
personas.backstory: Previously managed an in-house development team for a similar project

A: In-house development provides full control over the process and ensures high-quality results
C: Hybrid development offers a balanced approach, leveraging both internal and external expertise

personas.reservation: Concerned about the potential risks and quality issues associated with outsourcing
personas.reconsider_if: If the group prioritizes cost savings over control and quality
